ValidationRule.description: PreferredDateTime__c must be in the future when Status is Requested, Offered, or Booked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Requested"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Offered"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Booked") ), NOT(ISBLANK(PreferredDateTime__c)), PreferredDateTime__c < NOW() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Preferred Date/Time must be in the future for Requested, Offered, or Booked.
